title: Problem Details (RFC 9457)
description: Error body of every synchronous API (Content-Type application/problem+json). 'type' is a URI reference; 'about:blank' when no specific type applies.
$comment: Source: PRD RF-120, RNF-042, T-16; DISENO 3.8.5 (error model): problem types invalid-request (400), not-found (404), summary-pending (404, S2 and the S7 diff/breakdown while the summary is generated), invalid-state and idempotency-key-reuse (409), dependency-unavailable (503, with retry-after; SX-01a/SX-01b fallbacks never invent state). Extension member: correlationId (RF-120). Each response schema pins the allowed types per status. Audience: all. Residency: an error body never carries engagement data across regions (RF-092): detail must not contain engagement, firm or user identifiers when served by a global service (S1, S2).

type.description: Problem type (DISENO 3.8.5): invalid-request, not-found, summary-pending, invalid-state, idempotency-key-reuse or dependency-unavailable.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the problem type.

status.description: HTTP status code generated by the origin server.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of this occurrence (no workpaper content, no secrets).

instance.description: URI reference of this occurrence (usually the request path).

correlationId.description: Extension member: the correlation id of the request (RF-120).

examples.title: Summary is still being generated
